companyDescription: Space infrastructure + tactical UAS · Penguin/Stalker drones for NATO/US military + on-orbit space components · $498M backlog, still working through prior earnings-miss overhang
priceNote: Self-fetched today (no live-prices.json cache yet). Up 9.53% Jul 21 on $21.5M in Q2 follow-on Stalker UAS orders from the US military — the fourth straight quarter of steady defense demand. Still well off the 52-week high ($26.64) after two earlier earnings misses and dilution weighed on the stock earlier in 2026.
summary: Redwire reports Q2 2026 earnings on Aug 6, 2026, coming off back-to-back earnings misses and dilution that dragged the stock from a $26.64 high down near $8.74 before this week's contract-driven bounce. The setup has real substance behind it: $21.5M in follow-on Stalker UAS orders this quarter (plus ~$20M in Q1), a new high-eight-figure NATO Penguin Mk3 contract, and a $498M backlog — real revenue visibility, not just narrative. 10 analysts average a $15.67 target (+66% from here) on a Buy consensus. The risk is real too: this name has already missed twice and diluted shareholders this year, so the Aug 6 print needs to show the backlog converting into results, not just more contract headlines.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Redwire reports Thursday, Aug 6, 2026. After two consecutive earnings misses earlier in 2026, this print needs to show the $498M backlog and this quarter's contract wins converting into revenue and positive adjusted EBITDA trajectory, not just more headline contracts.

catalysts.name: NATO Penguin Mk3 Follow-On Orders
catalysts.description: Redwire won a high-eight-figure multi-year contract from an undisclosed NATO ally to deliver Penguin Mk3 UAS through a competitive tender — a follow-on order or additional NATO country adopting the platform would extend the backlog further.

catalysts.name: US Army/Navy/Marine Corps Stalker Orders
catalysts.description: $21.5M in Q2 follow-on Stalker UAS orders (after ~$20M in Q1) shows a steady cadence of US military demand — continuation of this pattern into Q3 would reinforce the revenue-visibility thesis ahead of earnings.

risks: Two consecutive earnings misses earlier in 2026 plus share dilution are the reason this stock is down from $26.64 to under $10 — the Aug 6 print carries real credibility risk, not a clean slate

Redwire's own history is the clearest bear case: shares pulled back specifically on 'investor disappointment following two consecutive earnings misses coupled with...share dilution and government contract delays'
Government contract delays remain a live risk even with a large backlog — award and delivery timing can slip on either side of a fiscal year
Broader 2026 space-sector selloff (ASTS -13%, SPCX -23% YTD at points this year) as capital rotated into SpaceX's IPO — sector-wide risk-off can drag RDW down even without company-specific bad news
Reworked credit lines ($50M outstanding term loan, $50M revolver) mean the balance sheet still needs the backlog to convert into cash, not just bookings

macroRisk.inflationNote: Core inflation remains above target and the 10-year yield sits near 4.48%, a headwind for small/mid-cap growth names with still-thin profitability like Redwire.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Government/defense contract revenue is less rate-sensitive than pure-growth tech, but RDW's balance sheet (credit-line dependence, recent dilution) makes it more exposed to a risk-off shock than a self-funded defense prime.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the NATO/US military demand backdrop is largely macro-independent, but a small-cap name that just reworked its credit lines and diluted shareholders this year is more exposed than most to a broad risk-off move around the Jul 28-29 FOMC.

th.summary: Redwire รายงานผล Q2 2026 วันที่ 6 ส.ค. 2026 หลังพลาดเป้า 2 ไตรมาสติดและ dilution ฉุดหุ้นจากจุดสูงสุด $26.64 ลงมาใกล้ $8.74 ก่อนจะเด้งขึ้นสัปดาห์นี้จากข่าวสัญญา เนื้อในมีของจริง: ยอดสั่ง Stalker UAS ต่อเนื่อง $21.5M ไตรมาสนี้ (บวก ~$20M ใน Q1) สัญญา NATO Penguin Mk3 มูลค่าหลักสิบล้านดอลลาร์ และ backlog $498M — เป็นรายได้ที่มองเห็นได้จริง ไม่ใช่แค่ narrative นักวิเคราะห์ 10 คนให้เป้าเฉลี่ย $15.67 (+66% จากราคานี้) เรตติ้ง Buy แต่ความเสี่ยงก็จริงเช่นกัน — หุ้นตัวนี้เคยพลาดเป้ามาแล้ว 2 ครั้งและเคย dilute ผู้ถือหุ้นปีนี้ ผลประกอบการ 6 ส.ค. ต้องพิสูจน์ว่า backlog แปลงเป็นผลจริง ไม่ใช่แค่ข่าวสัญญาเพิ่ม
